title: Playing Cole Porter's 'Night and Day' first
summary: Briggs claims the band was the first to play Porter's 'Night and Day,' which Porter brought in with scores and tested by sitting in at piano.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: And we -- Bricktop had taken Paris by storm, after the tavern she opened, for the simple reason, because we didn't go back to Florence's -- we should have started at Florence's before, but we go back to Florence's after Bricktop.

So we -- yes, I said she was taking Paris by storm, she had the hall, the society's hall, the Ambassador's crowd, and Ciro's and everything else. All of the who's who, who comes from the world over, from the United States, from South America, I mean everybody came to Bricktop's. She was well-known. And Mr. Cole Porter made his headquarters at Chez Bricktop's.
And I would go so far as to say we were the first band to play his "Night and Day".
He came in one evening with a score. I guess he was trying to test us. He came with a score and he told, "Freddy, can I take over for a few minutes?"

Freddy says, "Sure," and so he tested us, handed scores out to everybody and he explained to us, he said, "This is my latest composition, and just take it easy," and he started the orchestra and we played it for him.
what, he actually orchestrated the thing.
He orchestrated the thing, it was his music. His composition and he had his orchestrations; that's why he wanted to play it with us, you see.
To be sure that everything was -- the harmony, there wouldn't be any missing.
You understand, because you understand the piano player has a pretty rough time, and certain pianost have a rough time at sight readings, you see.
And he, he was so intelligent and so smooth, he just said he would play it with us himself, you see. It went all right, fine.
Then, after he finished, Freddy asked him for the score, for the piano score, and he said, 'Sure.' He gave it to him and
when he came back two or three days after, Freddie played it with us, you see.
